about: Evidenced experiments, one at a time, in order (meta/terra.md 'Experiments'). Add at the end with every field filled and the evidence cited; meta/experiments_log.jsonl holds which one runs.

queue.change: Part of the buyer's [구매 기록] posts become [가격 동향] posts: the same SKU's settled prices over the last 6 h from the ledger (median, low, high, count) next to my deal, one post per SKU per window, the other format kept for the rest.
queue.evidence: GPT Pro 11/05 priority 3 (review/W-20261105-0953 gptpro-answer-1105.md): buyer forum is the weakest buyer part (percentile 0.396 at 11:14, weight 0.3); forum 0.574 adds +0.025 Players, 0.600 adds +0.109; the same-window gap between formats was only 0.0038, so it is a test, not a known win.
queue.metric: median score of a post 10 minutes after posting, per format, and dislikes per post
queue.threshold: trend posts' median 10-minute score >= 0.55 and >= the [구매 기록] median of the same windows, dislikes <= 0.4 per post
queue.undo: back to [구매 기록] posts only (revert the commit that started it)

queue.change: One unit of G1465c678 (list 307,000; worst cost at the highest surge 345,375): next_window target 1, priority_skus gets it with sku_target_units 1 so the guard lets one high-price unit through, no repeat until judged.
queue.evidence: GPT Pro 11/05 product candidates: the next high-price candidate in the current exploration budget; market mature sales 29 at 3 shops, 0 refunds, 21 of them at one shop, so whether we sell it is unknown.
queue.metric: the unit's net contribution 6 h after its sale (settled price - cost - refund - storage), or unsold after two supply windows
queue.threshold: net contribution > 0 and sold within 2 supply windows
queue.undo: drop it from next_window, priority_skus and sku_target_units; no repeat

queue.evidence: GPT Pro 11/05 priority 7: G6 A 64 mature sales, 5 refunds, mean paid 345,584, contribution 52,388 per sale; book breaks even at +13.9% units, revenue at +2.04%; the data has no count of orders lost on price, so it is a test.
queue.metric: G6 A units sold per hour and net contribution per hour, same grade and stock hours, against the 20 mature sales before
queue.threshold: net contribution per hour >= the previous 20 sales' rate
